ModMetaData.name: Mantistanis Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces VanillaExpanded.VGeneticsE's GR_Mantistanis art (Megafauna module, all three lifeStages share one texPath) with custom generated Pyrelands-themed art (pyrelands_mantistanis_v2). The dessicated-corpse texture (GR_Dessicated_Mantistanis) stays on donor art. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/Megafauna/Insectoid/GR_Mantistanis_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
